ModulInfo.Title: System Information
ModulInfo.SettingsDesc: Backup or restore your extension data to your computer.

ModerationInfo.Title: Moderation
ModerationInfo.Item1: Moderation tools work in channels where you are a moderator or in your own channel.
ModerationInfo.Item2: While ban, timeout, and cross-ban settings are active in other channels, only the cross-ban setting is active in your own channel.
ModerationInfo.Item3: You must follow the channels where you are a moderator when applying a cross-ban.
ModerationInfo.Item4: While you cannot ban or timeout users who are moderators in your own channel, you can apply a cross-ban in other channels you follow and moderate, provided the user is not a moderator there.
ModerationInfo.Item5: The timeout duration cannot exceed 1 week.

StreamerModeSettings.Title: Streamer Mode
StreamerModeSettings.Item1: If streamer mode is active, you can view your own chat messages or take actions in certain windows for your own channel.
StreamerModeSettings.Item2: Advanced Moderation Mode activates the advanced moderation panel, which offers cross-bans, custom timeout durations, and detailed chat history, replacing Kick's default panel on user profiles.

LiveNotificationSettings.Title: Live Notification Settings
LiveNotificationSettings.Item1: You receive live broadcast notifications for the channels you follow.
LiveNotificationSettings.Item2: You can choose to receive either sound or visual notifications.
LiveNotificationSettings.Item3: You must be logged in to use this feature.

TagNotificationSettings.Title: Tag Notification Settings
TagNotificationSettings.Item1: You receive notifications from all clients where you are tagged.
TagNotificationSettings.Item2: You can choose to receive either sound or visual notifications.
TagNotificationSettings.Item3: Although message content is visible in visual notifications, it may be partially readable later (depending on what your Operating System allows).

ReplyNotificationSettings.Title: Reply Notification Settings
ReplyNotificationSettings.Item1: You receive notifications when someone replies to your message in chat.
ReplyNotificationSettings.Item2: You can choose to receive either sound or visual notifications.
ReplyNotificationSettings.Item3: Although message content is visible in visual notifications, it may be partially readable later depending on what your OS allows.

AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Title: Auto Stream Tab
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item1: If the stream audio setting is disabled, it is reapplied upon every tab focus or re-opening of tabs.
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item2: With the stream audio setting, streams are started muted to prevent sudden audio playback in the background. You can unmute directly from the top right corner of the Kick player.
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item3: Notifications for the streamer you follow must be enabled.
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item4: If the stream is already open in any of your tabs, it focuses on that tab; otherwise, it opens in a new tab.
AutoStreamOpenerSettings.Item5: When a streamer you follow starts a live broadcast, the stream automatically opens in a new tab.

SidebarChannelBackgroundSettings.Title: Sidebar Channel Background
SidebarChannelBackgroundSettings.Item1: Adds the profile picture of followed or recommended channels in the left sidebar as a background.
SidebarChannelBackgroundSettings.Item2: Applies a blur effect to the background image for a more aesthetic appearance.

AdBlockerSettings.Title: Ad Blocker
AdBlockerSettings.Item1: Automatically blocks live stream and video-on-demand (VOD) ads on Kick.
AdBlockerSettings.Item2: Provides an uninterrupted viewing experience by skipping ad segments at the network level without interrupting the video stream.
AdBlockerSettings.Item3: After changing the setting, the current stream page will automatically reload for the setting to fully take effect or disable.

StreamPreviewSettings.Title: Stream Preview
StreamPreviewSettings.Item1: Choose from 3 different video player sizes for stream preview.
StreamPreviewSettings.Item2: The player size is set to sm by default.
StreamPreviewSettings.Item3: Allows you to preview the stream in a small pop-up window when you hover over channels.

KeywordDetectorSettings.Title: Keyword Detector
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item1: The keyword detector status must be enabled for all features to work.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item2: If any of the words you added appear in a chat message, that message is highlighted with a special animation.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item3: You can customize the keyword highlight color as you wish and use the trash button to revert to the default color.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item4: Messages are marked with a flashing border so you can easily spot them.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item5: Keyword searches are case-sensitive. It matches the exact way you added the word.
KeywordDetectorSettings.Item6: You can enable or disable system (desktop) notifications and audio alerts from their respective settings.

ModLogsSettings.Title: Moderation Logs
ModLogsSettings.Item1: Displays quick access buttons at the top of the chat, such as audit logs, message history, chat clearing, and timeouts.

RaidBlockerSettings.Title: Raid Blocker
RaidBlockerSettings.Item1: The Raid Blocker status must be enabled for all functions to take effect.
RaidBlockerSettings.Item2: Add channels to the list that you do not want to be redirected to when a channel triggers a raid.
RaidBlockerSettings.Item3: If you are logged in, raids to channels you do not follow are canceled. This setting is enabled by default.
RaidBlockerSettings.Item4: The system automatically cancels raids within 3 seconds.

EmbedPreviewSettings.Title: Embed Viewer
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item1: View X (Twitter), YouTube, Kick, and Instagram links shared in chat directly within the page.
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item2: When clicking the button, it opens a draggable independent window in the top-left corner to display the content.
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item3: Choose from 3 different window sizes for content preview.
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item4: The window size is set to sm by default.
EmbedPreviewSettings.Item5: You can resize the opened window from the bottom-right corner up to 80% of the page width.

RoleHighlightsSettings.Title: Role Highlights
RoleHighlightsSettings.Item1: Highlights messages of moderators, VIPs, and OG users in the chat.
RoleHighlightsSettings.Item2: A light blue accent is applied for moderators, turquoise for OGs, and yellow for VIP users.
RoleHighlightsSettings.Item3: If a user has multiple roles, the priority order is determined as: Moderator > OG > VIP.

ChannelHiderSettings.Title: Channel Hider
ChannelHiderSettings.Item1: The channel hider status must be enabled for all functions to work.
ChannelHiderSettings.Item2: To hide a channel, simply click the ⊘ blocked button located on the recommended channels or the stream playing on the home page.
ChannelHiderSettings.Item3: You can find and remove channels you have hidden under the Channel Hider menu in the extension window.
ChannelHiderSettings.Item4: Add channels you don't want to see in the left sidebar recommended channels list and the auto-playing recommended streams on the home page.
ChannelHiderSettings.Item5: Channels you add will not be shown in the recommended streams section on the home page.

ViewerCountSettings.Title: Viewer Count
ViewerCountSettings.Item1: Allows you to see the hidden viewer count of a live channel while watching it on their channel.

EmotePreviewSettings.Title: Emote Preview
EmotePreviewSettings.Item1: Choose from 3 different window sizes for emote preview.
EmotePreviewSettings.Item2: The window size is set to sm by default.
EmotePreviewSettings.Item3: Allows you to see the enlarged version and details of the emote in a small pop-up window when you hover over emotes in the chat.

ChannelThemeSettings.Title: Set Channel Theme
ChannelThemeSettings.Item1: Change the backgrounds or text colors of any channel. These color pickers will be expanded.
ChannelThemeSettings.Item2: You can pick any color tones from anywhere using the color picker located to the right of the color palette.
ChannelThemeSettings.Item3: Although the channel name is fetched automatically, you can also type and add different channels manually.
ChannelThemeSettings.Item4: You can select a channel from the saved themes section to change its color palette or delete it.
ChannelThemeSettings.Item5: When the apply global theme setting is enabled, you can define a common theme independent of channels and pages, ensuring it applies to all pages without a custom theme.

LiveViewerCountTracker.TooltipLine1: These values are calculated mathematically based on the live viewer count.
LiveViewerCountTracker.TooltipLine2: Statistics are re-evaluated from that moment on every channel switch.

ModPanel.Title: KT with dp | Moderation
ModPanel.CrossReasonNote: Cross Ban info will be automatically added to the ban reason.

Tooltips.TargetMod: Target user is a moderator/broadcaster in this channel, so no action will be applied here. You can only use cross-ban.
Tooltips.StreamerModeMod: Streamer mode is active. Target user is a moderator in this channel, so no action will be applied here. Action will only be applied in your own channel (and others if cross-ban is enabled).
Tooltips.StreamerModeBoth: Streamer mode is active. Action will be applied both in this channel and your own channel.
Tooltips.StreamerModeOnlyYours: Streamer mode is active. Since you are not a moderator in this channel, action will be applied based on your own channel.
